functions.name: alerts_v1
functions.result: TABLE(title text, type text, date date)
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.alerts_v1(target_club uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(title text, type text, date date)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  with source_milestones as (
    select
      member.full_name,
      milestone.type,
      milestone.label,
      milestone.original_date
    from public.members member
    cross join lateral (
      values
        ('birthday', 'Aniversário', member.birth_date),
        ('prospect', 'Entrada como Prospect', member.prospect_joined_at),
        ('full_colors', 'Full Color', member.full_colors_at)
    ) as milestone(type, label, original_date)
    where member.club_id = target_club
      and milestone.original_date is not null
  ),
  milestone_dates as (
    select
      full_name,
      type,
      label,
      original_date,
      make_date(
        extract(year from current_date)::integer,
        extract(month from original_date)::integer,
        extract(day from original_date)::integer
      ) as this_year
    from source_milestones
  )
  select
    label || ': ' || full_name,
    type,
    case
      when this_year >= current_date
        then this_year
      else (this_year + interval '1 year')::date
    end
  from milestone_dates
  where case
    when this_year >= current_date
      then this_year
    else (this_year + interval '1 year')::date
  end <= current_date + 30

  union all

  select
    'Stock baixo: ' || product.name,
    'stock',
    current_date
  from public.products product
  where product.club_id = target_club
    and product.active = true
    and product.current_stock <= product.minimum_stock

  union all

  select
    'Documento a expirar: ' || document.name,
    'document',
    document.expires_at
  from public.documents document
  where document.club_id = target_club
    and document.expires_at between current_date and current_date + 30;
$function$

functions.name: dashboard_summary_v1
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.dashboard_summary_v1(target_club uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  total numeric;
  active_count integer;
  prospect_count integer;
  fee_count integer;
  income_month numeric;
  expense_month numeric;
begin
  select coalesce(sum(balance), 0)
  into total
  from public.treasury_account_balances_v1(target_club);

  select count(*)
  into active_count
  from public.members
  where club_id = target_club
    and status = 'active';

  select count(*)
  into prospect_count
  from public.members member
  where member.club_id = target_club
    and exists (
      select 1
      from public.member_positions member_position
      join public.club_positions club_position
        on club_position.id = member_position.position_id
      where member_position.member_id = member.id
        and member_position.is_primary = true
        and club_position.code = 'prospect'
    );

  select count(*)
  into fee_count
  from public.fee_obligations
  where club_id = target_club
    and status in ('pending', 'partial');

  select coalesce(sum(amount), 0)
  into income_month
  from public.treasury_transactions
  where club_id = target_club
    and kind = 'income'
    and date_trunc('month', transaction_date::timestamp)
      = date_trunc('month', now());

  select coalesce(sum(amount), 0)
  into expense_month
  from public.treasury_transactions
  where club_id = target_club
    and kind = 'expense'
    and date_trunc('month', transaction_date::timestamp)
      = date_trunc('month', now());

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'total_balance', total,
    'active_members', active_count,
    'prospects', prospect_count,
    'pending_fees', fee_count,
    'month_income', income_month,
    'month_expense', expense_month
  );
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  insert into public.profiles (
    id,
    full_name,
    email
  )
  values (
    new.id,
    coalesce(
      new.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name',
      split_part(new.email, '@', 1)
    ),
    new.email
  )
  on conflict (id) do nothing;

  return new;
end;
$function$

functions.name: member_milestones
functions.result: TABLE(member_id uuid, member_name text, milestone_type text, milestone_label text, original_date date, next_date date, days_until integer, years_count integer)
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.member_milestones(target_club uuid, days_ahead integer DEFAULT 30)
 RETURNS TABLE(member_id uuid, member_name text, milestone_type text, milestone_label text, original_date date, next_date date, days_until integer, years_count integer)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  with source_dates as (
    select
      m.id as member_id,
      m.full_name as member_name,
      v.milestone_type,
      v.milestone_label,
      v.original_date
    from public.members m
    cross join lateral (
      values
        ('birthday', 'Aniversário', m.birth_date),
        ('prospect_anniversary', 'Entrada como Prospect', m.prospect_joined_at),
        ('full_colors_anniversary', 'Full Color', m.full_colors_at)
    ) as v(milestone_type, milestone_label, original_date)
    where m.club_id = target_club
      and m.status in ('active', 'honorary')
      and v.original_date is not null
  ),
  next_occurrence as (
    select
      source_dates.*,
      case
        when make_date(
          extract(year from current_date)::int,
          extract(month from original_date)::int,
          extract(day from original_date)::int
        ) >= current_date
        then make_date(
          extract(year from current_date)::int,
          extract(month from original_date)::int,
          extract(day from original_date)::int
        )
        else make_date(
          extract(year from current_date)::int + 1,
          extract(month from original_date)::int,
          extract(day from original_date)::int
        )
      end as next_date
    from source_dates
  )
  select
    member_id,
    member_name,
    milestone_type,
    milestone_label,
    original_date,
    next_date,
    (next_date - current_date)::int as days_until,
    (
      extract(year from next_date)::int
      - extract(year from original_date)::int
    ) as years_count
  from next_occurrence
  where next_date <= current_date + days_ahead
  order by next_date, member_name;
$function$
